settings.title: When do I know if I can repot my plant?
settings.text: Your plant will give you a few clear signs! Look out for roots growing out from the drainage hole, soil has sinked considerably and an increase in frequency of watering. As a general rule, most plants love a slightly bigger home every 1 or 2 years.

settings.title: Should I trim my plant?
settings.text:
Yes, absolutely! Trimming/pruning is like giving a fresh haircut to your plant. It encourages the plant to grow back fuller and helps to neaten up the plant.

Always snip off any leaves that have completely turned yellow, brown, or crispy. These won't turn green again, and removing them signals the plant to redirect its energy into growing shiny new leaves instead.

settings.title: Do I need to fertilise my plant regularly?
settings.text:
Not necessarily! Fertilisers are more of a vitamin boost rather than actual food (plants make their own food using sunlight!). But if you want to accelerate its growth and see bigger, lusher leaves, a little fertiliser can definitely give it that extra push. Otherwise, your plant can and will do perfectly fine without it.

Never fertilise a plant that is undergoing stress, wilting, or root rot. Fertiliser is meant to boost a healthy plant, not rescue a sick one!

settings.title: How often should I water my plant?
settings.text: Watering frequency varies depending on the plant, potting mix, and lighting environment. We recommend checking the soil moisture with a chopstick before watering or refer to the plant’s care guide on our website!

settings.title: Can I overwater my plant?
settings.text: Yes, it’s possible. Overwatering is one of the most common causes of unhealthy plants. Always allow the potting mix to reach the recommended moisture level before the next watering cycle.

settings.title: My plant dropped a few leaves. Is this normal?
settings.text: Yes. It's common for plants to experience minor leaf drop after transport or when adjusting to its new environment. Given time and proper care, most plants will recover and begin producing new growth.

settings.title: Can I bring my plant down for repotting?
settings.text: Yes, we do offer repotting services and would be happy to assist you with your plant’s needs!

settings.title: Do you have non-toxic plants?
settings.text: Yes, we offer a range of plants that are suitable for homes with pets or children and we would recommend dropping by our New Bahru store to allow us to better assist you!

settings.title: Will my plant look exactly like the one on the website?
settings.text: Just like us, every plant is a unique individual! There will naturally be slight variations in both height and overall shape as compared to the photos. But we’d always hand-picked the best looking plant for your order!

settings.title: When will ____ be back in stock?
settings.text:
The best way to stay in the loop is to keep a close lookout right here on our website or follow us on Instagram for the latest updates.

Have a specific question about an item? Feel free to drop us a DM!

settings.title: Do you ship internationally?
settings.text:
We do not ship our live plants internationally due to strict customs regulations and the fragile nature of shipping live items.

However, our pots and merchandise are available worldwide! If you are located outside of Singapore and have your eye on our accessories, please reach out to us directly via Instagram DM or drop us an email. Our team will gladly calculate the international shipping rates and help you complete your order.

settings.title: Can I refund or exchange my plant?
settings.text:
Because plants are live, perishable items, we are unable to accept returns or exchanges once the plant has left the shop. Once a plant has entered into its new home, its health depends entirely on its new environment (like light and watering habits) which is out of our hands, so we cannot take responsibility for its care after purchase.

Exchange is available for non-live items within 7 days of purchase. Please note that we reserve the right to decline an exchange if the item is returned to us in an unfavourable or unsellable condition.

settings.title: My plant is struggling a couple of weeks later. Can I get a refund?
settings.text:
Because plants are living organisms, we cannot offer refunds once they have been in a new environment for a few weeks. A plant's long-term health depends entirely on the care, light, and watering it receives in its new home, which is out of our control.

However, we don't want you to go through it alone! We are always happy to assist you the best we can. Reach out to us if you have any questions.
